name: vllm-project/humming
title: vLLM and Ant Group open-source Humming, one quantized GEMM kernel library across formats and GPUs
summary: vLLM and Ant Group released Humming, a JIT-compiled kernel library for quantized inference that covers many weight formats and GPU generations, including consumer SM120 cards. They report up to 5x kernel speedups and 14 to 43% higher end-to-end MoE throughput, so quantized models can run closer to their theoretical speed without a separate kernel per format.
